note.question: What determines an innovative scheduling approach called “advance notice” to manage hospital diagnostic practices?
note.overview: Inpatients are often treated as the “captive audience” for hospital diagnostic services, and they are notified only when service capacity is available. This arrangement causes significant chaos and inefficiencies in hospital operations. The paper proposes an innovative scheduling approach called “advance notice” to manage hospital diagnostic practices.
